Table 5-8: Description of sound alarm of buzzer

| Short single alarm   | Give this alarm when pressing any functional operation key                                                                                                             |
|----------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Continual alarm      | Give this alarm when UPS is under fault                                                                                                                                |
| Distant alarm        | Give this alarm once 2 seconds when battery is discharging Give this alarm once 1 second when battery is discharging and voltage is lower than low-voltage alarm point |
